text_block_list.text:
Seeing Grass Wonder looking exhausted, I 
decided to take her to the infirmary to 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. Thank you for being so 
thoughtful...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
This is a great chance to rest. Please 
make sure to relax too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Oh? My, oh my? Where on earth am I~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... doesn't seem to be here. Is 
there anything around—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a whole tea set over there. Even 
traditional authentic Gyokuro tea 
leaves...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since it's so nice and quiet here, maybe 
I'll take a little rest~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—A pleasant wind and fresh air. A 
beautiful sky stretching out endlessly...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Once you settle down like this, it's 
surprisingly cozy here...♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: What kind of dream was it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Having tea in a wonderful place— it 
was such a lovely dream~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I got to rest up properly. 
I'd love to take you there sometime too, 
Trainer♪

Judging by Grass Wonder's demeanor, it 
seemed she had recovered her spirits.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh? Oh my, oh my? Where is... the tea?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I thought I was drinking tea just a moment 
ago... So why am I in the infirmary...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
No, was I just having a strange dream, I 
wonder~?

It seemed Grass Wonder wasn't able to get 
much rest.
